frontmatter.name: deploy
frontmatter.description: Deploy applications to AWS. Triggers on phrases like: deploy to AWS, host on AWS, run this on AWS, AWS architecture, estimate AWS cost, generate infrastructure. Analyzes any codebase and deploys to optimal AWS services.

frontmatter.name: aws-architecture-diagram
frontmatter.description: Generate validated AWS architecture diagrams as draw.io XML using official AWS4 icon libraries. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, generate, or design AWS architecture diagrams, cloud infrastructure diagrams, or system design visuals. Also triggers for requests to visualize existing infrastructure from CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform code. Supports two modes: analyze an existing codebase to auto-generate diagrams, or brainstorm interactively from scratch. Exports .drawio files with optional
frontmatter.argument-hint: [describe your architecture or say 'analyze' to scan codebase]

nodes.label: CDK TypeScript Default IaC
nodes.rationale: CDK TypeScript is default because it is most expressive, has best IDE support, generates CloudFormation, and provides type safety

nodes.label: IAM Least Privilege
nodes.rationale: Never use wildcard for resources or actions; enumerate specific ARNs and use conditions where possible

nodes.label: Private Subnets for Compute
nodes.rationale: Public IPs on compute invite direct attack; route outbound through NAT Gateway; ALB is only public-facing component

nodes.label: Application Management Service
nodes.rationale: EB is an application management service where user provides code and AWS manages everything underneath including deployment, scaling, patching, monitoring, health response

nodes.label: Supplier/Students Naming Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Codebase uses supplier in file/class names but domain is actually students; database table is students and UI references students

nodes.label: LabRole IAM Constraint
nodes.rationale: All AWS deployments MUST use LabRole; do NOT create or refer to any other IAM resources

nodes.label: Confidence Scoring Rules
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED=1.0 always; INFERRED picks from 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 based on evidence strength; AMBIGUOUS=0.1-0.3; never use 0.5

nodes.label: Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: Lowercase only [a-z0-9_], format {stem}_{entity} where stem is full repo-relative path joined with underscore; must match AST extractor ID

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: Query must be expanded against actual graph vocabulary because graphify has no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language match — literal matcher returns 0 hits without expansion

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges; use AMBIGUOUS if unsure; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores
